native_vs_imposed_missingness: Both tables contain genuine source NaNs. Only finite original cells may be hidden/revealed for scored offline experiments; genuine missing cells have no reference truth and cannot be counted as validated completions. A proposal that inserts generated labels cannot enlarge measured-oracle counts.
validation_boundary: Structural/rule consistency is not an independent property measurement. Density/model predictions or correlated outputs cannot certify their own truth. All arms need identical allowed information, hidden-cell or bundled-query budgets, split policy and stop criteria.
cross_material_claim_boundary: UCSB experimental transport and JARVIS computed solid-state properties are two different environments. Running both supports task-family breadth only; cross-domain generalization requires fixed policy/hyperparameters and explicit unseen-chemistry or heldout-environment design. Different sources do not by themselves certify transfer.
MADE_conclusion: MIT official ICML2026 environment is a close comparator. Its ORB/MACE/analytic oracles are ML potentials/LennardJones, not independent real measurements; default MP/API or model setup not executed.
